WITH zone_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_zone_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM fct_trips
    GROUP BY pickup_zone_id
),
ranked_zones AS (
    SELECT 
        trip_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trip_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM zone_trips
),
top_10_trips AS (
    SELECT SUM(trip_count) AS top_10_count
    FROM ranked_zones
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
total_trips AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM fct_trips
)
SELECT 
    (top_10_trips.top_10_count * 100.0 / total_trips.total_count) AS percentage
FROM top_10_trips, total_trips

WITH zone_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_zone_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM fct_trips
    GROUP BY pickup_zone_id
),
ranked_zones AS (
    SELECT 
        trip_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trip_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM zone_trips
),
top_10_trips AS (
    SELECT SUM(trip_count) AS top_10_count
    FROM ranked_zones
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
total_trips AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM fct_trips
)
SELECT
